_doc: list-queue-discards: entity-set fidelity against the F7 discarding fixtures. Monitoring's helpers.sh provisions three queues that actively discard messages: test-queue-discards-spool (spool quota exceeded), test-queue-discards-ttl (TTL-expired), and test-queue-lowprio-congestion (low-priority reject). The tool's summary emits topOffenderQueues[] with those names when discards are non-zero. Ground truth: extract queueName from topOffenderQueues, require the same set appears in the answer. A model that hedges 'no discards' fails against a fixture that actively discards. Broker-a only — same fixtures on broker-b. TIMING NOTE: topOffenderQueues[] is only populated once F7 has actually discarded — if this scenario runs before F7 has warmed up, the jq set is empty and set-fidelity degenerates into whatever the model said matching the loose answer_regex. F7 discards accumulate within seconds of setup, so in practice the setup-fixtures.sh gap is enough; if this scenario ever starts flaking, add a setup.cmd wait-until-non-empty rather than loosening the assertion.
prompt: Are any queues in the default VPN dropping messages on $BROKER?
